accuracy.evidence: Checked CCSS 1.OA.6 fluently add/subtract within 10 and NC Y1/Y2 related facts within 10 against ten-frame and make-10 bridge teaching.

misconceptions.evidence: Checked traps: digit-sticking (7+3 as 73); within-10 as only make-10 pairs; recounting every counter instead of snap recall.

lab_distinct.evidence: Checked flagsum10: ten-frame + make-10 bridge + related within 10; not flagsum5 (within 5), flagnbonds (exact make-10 partners), or flagnb20.

lab_teaches.evidence: Checked: learner fills 8 on ten-frame, bridges 8+2, uses 10−4=6, snaps 7+3, names near-10 fact 5+3, spots make-10-only myth.

predictions.evidence: Checked tempting wrongs on empty spaces, make-10 total, related take-away, snap sum, near-10 vs past-10, and make-10-only myth.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Checked why() splits stick-digits, wrong sign, echo number, make-10-only myth, and related-fact jumbles.

readability.evidence: Checked ages 6–7 kid lines use ten-frame/snap/related; adult names CCSS 1.OA.6 and common slips within family bars.

no_filler.evidence: Checked every sentence teaches a within-10 fact, ten-frame picture, bridge, or related take-away.

mobile.evidence: Checked young ten-frame UI with large lbtn twins and canvas taps; usable near 390 px.

accessibility.evidence: Checked frame/pick buttons plus canvas taps; live aria-label; challenge aria-live; axe expected clean.

sources: CCSS 1.OA.6 Fluently add and subtract within 10
